import 'package:conflux/conflux.dart';
import 'package:conflux/val.dart' as direct;

void main() {
  final Schema<String> text = Val.string().optional().minLength(1).refine((value) => value.isNotEmpty);
  final Result<String, NonEmptyList<ValidationIssue>> result = text.safeParse('x');
  final String output = result.map((value) => value.toUpperCase()).parseForFixture();
  final Schema<String?> nullable = text.nullable().refine((value) => value == null || value.isNotEmpty);
  final String? cleared = nullable.parse(null);
  final Map<String, Schema<Object?>> fields = {'text': text, 'nullable': nullable};
  final Map<String, Object?> object = direct.Val.object(fields).parse({'nullable': null});
  if (output != 'X' || cleared != null || object.containsKey('text')) throw StateError('Unexpected output');
}

extension FixtureResult<T> on Result<T, NonEmptyList<ValidationIssue>> {
  T parseForFixture() => getOrThrowWith(ValidationException.new);
}
